z3_encoding.rationale: isinstance(rhs, Parameter) is True iff the runtime type of rhs is Parameter or a subclass. Empirically issubclass(CallableParameter, Parameter)==True and int/str are not subclasses, so the predicate's True-set over the seeded enum is exactly {Parameter, CallableParameter}.

classification_rationale: The branch is an isinstance() type dispatch on a live, caller-supplied object (rhs, the right operand of '<' on a Parameter). Its truth value is determined by rhs's runtime Python type, not by any tractable integer/boolean/string expression over CLI/YAML inputs. Z3 cleanly solves the ABSTRACTED enum model (sat for both True and False), but the underlying decision is runtime type identity. There is no env/filesystem/GPU probe; the dependency is purely the dynamic type of the operand. Per the workflow taxonomy this is runtime-dependent (isinstance on a live object), even though both witnesses are concrete and the abstract enum model is fully sat.

true_examples.proof: z3 sat (model rhs=Parameter) AND executed in-container: (Parameter('a',1) < Parameter('b',2)) is True

true_examples.by_value: issubclass(CallableParameter, Parameter) == True so a CallableParameter rhs also takes the True branch
true_examples.proof: z3 sat (model rhs=CallableParameter) AND issubclass(CallableParameter, Parameter)==True confirmed in-container

false_examples.proof: z3 sat (Not(predicate), model rhs=int) AND executed in-container: (Parameter('a',1) < 5) is True, (Parameter('a',1) < 0) is False
executed in-container: (Parameter('s','abc') < 'abd') is True, (Parameter('s','abc') < 'abb') is False

pure_helper_note: No pure helper extractable: the predicate is a built-in isinstance() type check on a live object, not a boolean/arithmetic expression over scalar inputs. CrossHair operates on value-typed inputs and cannot meaningfully exercise runtime type identity of an arbitrary operand here, so no CrossHair run was performed.

reified_test.pins: Both branches of the isinstance guard: TRUE (Parameter/CallableParameter rhs -> .value vs .value) and FALSE (int/str rhs -> .value vs rhs).

notes: z3 4.16.0; both True and False are sat over the abstracted enum model.
issubclass(CallableParameter, Parameter)==True; int/str are not subclasses -> True-set = {Parameter, CallableParameter}, False-set = {int, str}.
Runtime behavior of both branches confirmed by direct execution in-container (not hand-waved).
classification=runtime-dependent because the guard is isinstance on a live operand; solver_status=sat reflects that the abstracted enum model is decidable and both polarities are realizable.
